text:
sara_support: FYI AcmeCorp is seeing intermittent 503/504s on hosted inference. It happens when they run a single client job that does embeddings followed by a long generate in the same HTTP/2 stream.

sara_support: Customer provided a short repro and logs, says it started yesterday after a spike in concurrent pipelines.

sam_oncall: @sara_support can you paste the minimal repro curl they used? also what's their concurrency and avg seq len?

sara_support: Repro they sent: ```curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-large","steps":1,"input":"<~8k tokens context>"}'``` They run ~6 pipelines per client connection (embed -> generate), typical generate ~2k tokens.

maria_engineer: Interesting — mixed embed+generate on same connection could exhaust HTTP/2 WINDOW/stream-level flow and cause upstream stalls if KV cache growth blocks write windows. Need logs from the gateway showing `RST_STREAM`/`WINDOW_UPDATE` behavior.

ingrid_support: I got these gateway lines from the customer: ```2026-02-12T14:03:12Z gateway error: upstream timeout=30s, code=503, stream=15
2026-02-12T14:03:12Z http2: RST_STREAM id=15 err=STREAM_CANCEL
2026-02-12T14:03:12Z transport: write blocked, writeQueue=98, remoteWindow=0```

sam_oncall: @maria_engineer can you check if the gateway's HTTP/2 per-connection window default is hitting zero on large KV writes? Also check whether SDK is reusing connections without adjusting keepalives.

maria_engineer: I'll grep the gateway traces. Early guess: embeddings small, quickly fill stream, then generate writes huge chunks (kv cache+tokens) and upstream's send buffer fills -> remoteWindow goes 0 -> gateway times out waiting to send -> 503.

priya_sre: Quick mitigation we can suggest to customer: 1) split embed and generate into separate connections (or pause briefly between calls), 2) set SDK option `max_concurrency=2` or `http2_keepalive=60s`, 3) use the `X-Prefer-Low-Latency: true` header to prefer smaller batches while we investigate.

ingrid_support: I sent that to the customer and they tried splitting calls into two connections — their repro dropped 503s immediately. They confirmed temp fix.

maria_engineer: Filed INC-2026-158 in internal tracker: investigating HTTP/2 flow control defaults and gateway backpressure handling for mixed pipelines. Possible kernel-level write batching tweak or increase default remoteWindow.

support-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-158 opened by maria_engineer (priority: P2).

sam_oncall: Action items: maria to prototype gateway windows change, priya to run load test with mixed embed+generate workloads, ingrid to keep customer updated and offer dedicated trial if they need SLA. ETA for initial patch: 24-36h.

ingrid_support: Customer is OK with that timeline but asked for a short note we can send them — I drafted this: "We're investigating a gateway-level flow-control edge-case that can occur when many embed+generate pipelines share a single HTTP/2 connection. A temporary mitigation is to separate the calls or limit per-connection concurrency; we're rolling a targeted fix and will update you within 36 hours."

sara_support: Thanks team. logging followup: if you need their request IDs I have them, ping me.

priya_sre: I'll start the stressed e2e with 8 pipelines/conn and 2k token generates, will post results here.

maria_engineer: Found a consistent repro in staging: gateway remoteWindow drops to 0 under backpressure; writing patch to increase default stream window and to prioritize WINDOW_UPDATE frames earlier. Will open PR shortly.

support-bot: PR #3821 opened by maria_engineer -> gateway: increase http2 stream window / expedite window_update.

ingrid_support: Customer responded "thanks, splitting connections helped, please let us know when fix lands." I confirmed we'll update them when PR merges.

sam_oncall: Nice work. Keep comms tight. If customer needs immediate SLA, offer Dedicated short trial (sales loop).

maria_engineer: PR merged to canary, deploying now to gateway-canary. Will monitor error rate and p95 latency for mixed workloads.

support-bot: Deploy to gateway-canary started by ci-bot.

priya_sre: Canary run shows error rate down ~95% for the repro workload, memory and CPU similar. I'll schedule a gradual rollout if stable for 2h.

ingrid_support: Sent customer update: "We deployed a canary fix that addresses the flow-control path. We're observing a ~95% reduction in errors for the repro; we'll keep you updated and plan a global rollout if stable." :thumbsup:

sara_support: Marking this thread as tracked. Will update last_message_ts when we close with final rollout note.
